onset.Description: Onset of the event (measured from the beginning of the acquisition) in seconds.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from the onset) in seconds.

stim_file.Description: The auditory stimulus file that was presented during this trial of the experiment.

trigger_file.Description: The trigger file that was presented during this trial of the experiment.

noise_file.Description: The auditory noise that was presented during this trial of the experiment.

video_file.Description: The video file that was presented during this trial of the experiment.

condition.Description: The condition of the current trial, e.g. silence or video.

snr.Description: Signal-to-noise ratio between the stimulus ("stim_file") and the noise ("noise_file"). If this value is 100, no noise was presented

TaskDescription: Silent resting-state recording bookending the active listening blocks. Participants sat quietly with no auditory stimulus presented; used as a baseline for the speech-evoked response analyses.
Instructions: Sit quietly and relax. No action is required.
